question: Before confirming an Interac e-Transfer to someone using Autodeposit, the recipient name shown differs from the person you intended to pay. What should you do?
generated_answer: Interac e-Transfer Autodeposit is a service that allows you to automatically deposit Interac e-Transfer funds into your bank account. To use this service, you must first register your email address and/or mobile phone number with your bank. Once registered, you will be notified by email or text message when an Interac e-Transfer is sent to you. You can then confirm the deposit of the funds into your bank account. If you receive an Interac e-Transfer from someone you do not know, you should not confirm the deposit. This could be a scam. If you are unsure about the authenticity of an Interac e-Transfer, you should contact your bank for assistance.
